walkthrough.short: Join {hand} hands with {pairs}, forearms up, and walk round each other, {amount}.
walkthrough.long: Join {hand} hands with {pairs} — forearms up, palms together, elbows bent — and walk forward round each other, keeping the joined hands over the one spot between you, {amount}. Look at each other the whole way; the free hand hangs at your side. {where}

walkthrough.short: Robins only. Join {hand} hands in the middle and walk round each other, {amount}; larks stand.
walkthrough.long: Robins only. Join {hand} hands in the middle — forearms up, palms together, elbows bent — and walk forward round each other, {amount}, keeping the joined hands over the one spot between you. The larks stand on their places and wait for you. {where}

walkthrough.short: Larks only. Join {hand} hands in the middle and walk round each other, {amount}; robins stand.
walkthrough.long: Larks only. Join {hand} hands in the middle — forearms up, palms together, elbows bent — and walk forward round each other, {amount}, keeping the joined hands over the one spot between you. The robins stand on their places and wait for you. {where}
